title: 2026 UK ETS SAF purchase-delivery proposal QA controls

sources.title: Treatment of sustainable aviation fuel consultation accessible webpage
Treatment of sustainable aviation fuel consultation

facts.source_fact: The SAF document is a consultation and closed on 15 June 2026.
Claims are intended to relate to an aircraft operator's activities in the relevant UK ETS scheme year.
The Authority proposes that SAF may be purchased within, or at most three months before, the relevant scheme year.
The Authority proposes delivery to an aerodrome fuelling system or aircraft before 31 March following the scheme year.
The Authority proposes proof of purchase and delivery to the UK ETS regulator.
The proposal recognises practical timing around January use and December purchases.
Proof of delivery is intended to help ensure fuel is used by aviation.
Proof of purchase and delivery is intended to guard against double counting and fraudulent claims.
The consultation response had not yet established final legislative wording in the source reviewed.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat proposal text as enacted law.

facts.source_fact: The proposed timing rules concern emissions-reduction claims, not physical fuel-emissions measurement at parcel level.
